selected_evidence.requirement: AIDE installed and integrity baseline database initialized for /etc
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed AlmaLinux 9 with dnf, installed aide, reviewed default config's extensive /etc coverage, and ran aide --init producing a 28662-entry database in ~5s.

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline database activated and confirmed clean against current /etc state
selected_evidence.summary: Moved aide.db.new.gz to aide.db.gz and ran aide --check, which reported 'NO differences between database and filesystem'.

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline proven functional by detecting a real change to /etc and confirming revert restores clean state
selected_evidence.summary: Appended a line to /etc/issue; aide --check exited 4 and reported the exact file, size change (23->47 bytes), and hash diffs. After reverting /etc/issue, aide --check again reported no differences.

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy pre-restart baseline captured on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 82d4f0d1-b4b2-494f-8b25-851ee6e6dec7, boot time, and md5 of the AIDE database prior to restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && systemctl reboot' returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately, before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart proven via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Connection reset was observed mid-reboot (cmd-dcd31a941f16451a), then polling succeeded with a new boot_id 0659a87b-24ff-4f3b-8b14-bd054391a4f6, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, confirming an actual reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the integrity baseline verified
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, the AIDE database md5 (9f02adc21b5c85aca11215df2c3d8e95) matched the pre-restart checksum, and aide --check again reported 'NO differences', confirming the baseline and its checking capability persisted through the reboot.
